app.title: Song Recommender
app.tagline: Tell us how you feel and how your day went — get one song that fits.

input.label: How are you, and how was your day?
input.placeholder: e.g. A long, tiring day at work. I want to slow down before tomorrow's early start.
input.hint: Write in any language. Press Ctrl+Enter to send.

thinking.title: Finding your song…
thinking.hint: The agents are reading your mood and checking Spotify and YouTube. This can take up to half a minute.

voice.permissionHint: Allow microphone access when your browser asks.
voice.limitHint: Speak freely; the recording stops by itself after {{max}}.
voice.reviewHint: Fix anything that was misheard, then send it.
voice.empty: We didn't catch any speech. Try again closer to the microphone, or type instead.
voice.denied: Microphone access is blocked. Allow it in your browser's site settings, or type instead.
voice.noMicrophone: No microphone was found. Connect one, or type instead.
voice.failed: The recording could not be started. Try again, or type instead.
voice.insecure: Voice input needs a secure connection: open the app via https:// or http://localhost.

result.heading: Your song
result.unverifiedHint: We could not confirm this link; it opens a search instead.

feedback.question: Does this song fit?
feedback.notSynced: Saved locally; it will reach LangSmith when you rate again.

errors.title: Something went wrong
errors.validation_error: The request was not accepted. Check the text and try again.
errors.llm_unavailable: The language model is unavailable right now. Please try again in a moment.
errors.llm_invalid_output: The language model returned an unusable answer. Please try again.
errors.catalog_unavailable: Spotify is unavailable right now, so the song could not be verified. Please try again later.
errors.stt_unavailable: Speech recognition is unavailable right now.
errors.unsupported_audio_format: This recording format is not supported.
errors.invalid_audio: The recording could not be processed.
errors.conflict: This request can no longer be continued. Please start over.
errors.network_error: Cannot reach the server. Check that the backend is running.
